description: This Java class 'ApacheFopWorker' handles PDF generation and transformation using Apache FOP, including configuration, transformation methods, and temporary file management.

classes.name: ApacheFopWorker
classes.description: Final utility class for PDF transformation and configuration using Apache FOP, with methods for creating factory instances, transforming files/streams, and managing temporary files.

classes.name: LocalResolver
classes.description: Inner class implementing URIResolver to resolve resource locations during transformation.

methods.name: getFactoryInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of FopFactory, initializing it with configuration and font resources if necessary.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Performs transformation of XSL-FO files or streams into specified output formats, optionally using stylesheets.

methods.name: createFopInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Fop instance for rendering, with optional FOUserAgent for encryption settings.

methods.name: createTempFoXmlFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary XML file for FO input, scheduled for deletion on exit.

methods.name: createTempResultFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary result file, scheduled for deletion on exit.

methods.name: getUserPasswordDefault
methods.description: Returns default user password for PDF encryption.

methods.name: getOwnerPasswordDefault
methods.description: Returns default owner password for PDF encryption.

methods.name: getAllowCopyContentDefault
methods.description: Returns default permission for copying content.

methods.name: getAllowEditContentDefault
methods.description: Returns default permission for editing content.

methods.name: getAllowEditAnnotationsDefault
methods.description: Returns default permission for editing annotations.

methods.name: getAllowAccessContentDefault
methods.description: Returns default permission for accessing content.

methods.name: getAllowFillInFormsDefault
methods.description: Returns default permission for filling in forms.

methods.name: getAllowAssembleDocumentDefault
methods.description: Returns default permission for assembling documents.

methods.name: getAllowPrintHqDefault
methods.description: Returns default permission for high-quality printing.

methods.name: getEncryptMetadataDefault
methods.description: Returns default setting for encrypting metadata.
